brief:
Settlers attacked agricultural crops in areas east of Tubas, Shehab Wire reported. The assault targeted Palestinian farming land in the region, damaging crops belonging to local farmers.

The incident marks the latest in a series of confrontations between Palestinian cultivators and Israeli settlers operating in the occupied West Bank. Such attacks on Palestinian agriculture have been documented repeatedly across the territory, with farmers facing threats to their harvests and livelihoods from settler violence.
